module_summary: Source-synchronous DDR input: buffers the received clock via target-specific primitives and captures input_d on both edges with an iddr child into two SDR outputs.

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: DDR input data sampled on both edges of the I/O clock by the iddr.

anchors.name: output_q1
anchors.why: Rising-edge captured data output from the iddr.

anchors.name: output_q2
anchors.why: Falling-edge captured data output from the iddr.

anchors.name: input_clk
anchors.why: Received forwarded clock buffered into clk_io and output_clk.

anchors.name: clk_int
anchors.why: Internal buffered clock feeding output_clk to logic.

groups.name: clock_buffering
groups.description: Target-specific BUFG/BUFIO/BUFR or passthrough distribution of the input clock.

groups.name: ddr_capture
groups.description: iddr capturing input_d on both clock edges into q1/q2.
